theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ftl_normal_frobenius_restriction
theorems.statement: ∀ (E F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [IsGalois ℚ E] (hEF : E ≤ F) (V : ValuationSubring E) (W : ValuationSubring F) (ℓ : ℕ), (∀ x : E, IntermediateField.inclusion hEF x ∈ W ↔ x ∈ V) → ∀ g : F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F, W.IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ → ∃! e : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, V.IsFrobeniusAt e ℓ ∧ ∀ x : E, IntermediateField.inclusion hEF (e x) = g (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
